## Receivables implementation checkpoint
Implemented Phase 2 Position #18 screen `receivables` (Outstanding dues / Udhaar, 52 pts) under workspace `finance_cashier`.
- New `src/screens/Receivables.tsx` and App route display live debt aging cards (0–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+ days), outstanding accounts receivable list, search/filtering, debt settlement modal, restricted write-off modal, and invoices & direct payments tab.
- Debt settlement (`POST /finance/ar/{ar_id}/settle`) and invoice collection (`POST /finance/invoices/{invoice_id}/payments`) use Idempotency-Key headers, single-flight locks, amount bounds validation, and handle `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` (409) with staff guidance.
- Enforced `rule:61ddcf1727`: Write-off (`POST /finance/ar/{ar_id}/write-off`) is strictly restricted to `finance.ar.write_off` (Owner and Hospital Admin). Cashiers see this action disabled with explanatory title; cashier write-off attempts are refused by server with 403 FORBIDDEN. Mandatory write-off reason is validated (5–500 chars, rejects shorter input with 422).
